Information Security Analyst — Crown Agents Bank (fixture posting text)

About the role
We are looking for an Information Security Analyst to join our London security team.
You will support the monitoring, triage and investigation of security events and
contribute to the bank's cyber risk and assurance activities.

Key responsibilities
- Monitor security alerts and support incident response triage.
- Investigate phishing reports and map observed behaviour to MITRE ATT&CK.
- Support vulnerability management and remediation tracking.
- Help maintain security policies, standards and control documentation.
- Produce clear written reporting for technical and non-technical readers.

Essential requirements
- A degree in information security, cyber security or a related discipline.
- Understanding of phishing analysis, endpoint assessment and network security.
- Scripting or automation ability in Python or PowerShell.
- Familiarity with regular expressions and log analysis.
- Strong written communication and attention to detail.

Desirable
- Experience with Splunk or another SIEM platform.
- Experience working in a Security Operations Centre (SOC).
- Knowledge of ISO 27001 and GDPR.
- CompTIA Security+ or equivalent certification.

Location: London, United Kingdom (hybrid).
Right to work: applicants must already hold the right to work in the United Kingdom.
